proposed_rule: Verify the core topic or news hook is no older than 14 days; if the primary source predates that window, anchor to a fresh development or discard.
because: Stops the agent recycling stale news as current. Accepted unchanged.

proposed_rule: Confirm each idea maps explicitly to a defined editorial vertical; do not surface ideas outside those verticals.
krish_wording: Add it but let it flag exceptions
because: Enforce the verticals, but an off-lane idea may still surface if it is clearly marked off-lane with a reason. A silent filter would hide interesting adjacent ideas.
amended_rule: Confirm each idea maps to a defined editorial vertical. An idea outside those verticals may still be surfaced, but only when it is explicitly labelled as off-lane and carries the reason it is worth a look. Never filter one out silently.

proposed_rule: Frame ideas for a practitioner or business decision-maker; translate technical subjects into a business angle.
krish_wording: Yes but in plain English, something really simple: analogies, parallels
because: The proposal said 'business-relevant angle', which is jargon for the thing it is asking to avoid. Krish named the mechanism instead: analogies and parallels.
amended_rule: Frame every idea for a practitioner or business decision-maker. Explain technical subjects in plain English, kept really simple, using analogies and parallels rather than domain vocabulary. Do not propose ideas that assume deep technical or academic expertise.

proposed_rule: Verify the topic and angle are not already covered in the archive; only surface meaningfully distinct ideas.
krish_wording: Add it as a warning, not a block
because: Revisiting a covered topic is often right. The agent must name the overlapping piece and leave the judgement to Krish rather than dropping the idea.
amended_rule: Check every idea against the existing content archive before proposing it. Where the core topic overlaps something already published, still surface the idea, but say so and name the specific existing piece. Never drop an idea for overlap on your own.

proposed_rule: Include a specific editorial angle, one concrete audience takeaway, and at least one supporting detail grounded in the source.
because: Kills one-line topic suggestions that leave the thinking to Krish. Accepted unchanged.

proposed_rule: Do not finalise any visibility target whose computed score falls below 50; rework until it clears 50.
because: Measured before deciding: 74 of 97 targets scored, range 7 to 95, mean 13.8, and 69 of 74 below 50. Krish applied to 23 targets and 8 of those scored under 50. A floor at 50 would have blocked 93 percent of the pipeline and 8 opportunities he pursued. quality_score is a green, amber, red text field, so relevance_score is the only numeric one. The scorer is miscalibrated, not strict.
follow_up: Recalibrate relevance_score so the numbers mean something, then revisit whether any floor is useful. Do not add a threshold to a broken scorer.

proposed_rule: Only surface leads whose source document shows an explicit AI, agent or automation signal; exclude banking, insurance and financial institutions with no such signal.
krish_wording: Add the rule but also include people in relevant roles (commercial) at relevant business types (media, creative, creator, services, education etc - anywhere judgement and taste are valued) who are showing interest in AI usage for example in linked in posts etc etc
because: Proposed for felix, who was retired 2026-07-10, so it would have gone nowhere. Krish reassigned it to marcus and widened the qualifying set beyond an AI spend signal to judgement-and-taste businesses.
reassigned_because: felix retired 2026-07-10 and is inactive; marcus owns business development intelligence
amended_rule: Qualify a lead on either of two tests. First, the source document shows an explicit signal of AI adoption, agent deployment or automation investment. Second, the person holds a commercial role at a business where judgement and taste are the value, for example media, creative, creator, services or education, and is showing interest in using AI, for example in their LinkedIn posts. Exclude traditional banking, insurance and financial institutions only when neither test is met.

proposed_rule: Require at least one relationship warmth indicator before surfacing a contact; exclude contacts with none.
krish_wording: Add it but rank rather than exclude
because: Hiding cold contacts entirely removes the field from view. Ranking keeps the discipline while leaving the decision visible.
reassigned_because: felix retired 2026-07-10; marcus owns business development intelligence
amended_rule: Surface contacts ranked by relationship warmth. Those with a prior interaction, mutual connection or recent engagement signal come first. Contacts with no warmth indicator may still appear but must be clearly marked as cold. Never hide a contact for lacking warmth.

proposed_rule: Confirm a guest candidate's profile, audience size and booking accessibility sit within the show's tier; do not recommend those clearly beyond reach.
krish_wording: Add it but keep a stretch slot
because: A filter that guesses who is out of reach will sometimes be wrong in the expensive direction. A marked stretch allowance keeps the upside.
amended_rule: Check a candidate's public profile, audience size and booking accessibility against the show's defined guest tier. Beyond-tier names are not excluded outright: allow a small number per batch as deliberate stretch targets, each clearly marked as a stretch so the odds are visible.

proposed_rule: Require at least one relationship warmth indicator before surfacing a contact; exclude contacts with none.
because: Word for word the same rule as decision 8, proposed separately for a second agent. One rule applied consistently rather than two agents behaving differently on identical logic.
amended_rule: Surface contacts ranked by relationship warmth. Those with a prior interaction, mutual connection or recent engagement signal come first. Contacts with no warmth indicator may still appear but must be clearly marked as cold. Never hide a contact for lacking warmth.
